name: uv (Astral Python toolchain)
description: Installs the uv/uvx binaries system-wide and (optionally) a managed CPython into a shared, world-readable location so every user in the container gets the same interpreter.

version.description: uv version to install. 'latest' uses the newest release, otherwise a bare version like '0.9.2'.

pythonVersion.description: CPython version to pre-install via `uv python install`. Set to '-' to skip installing a managed Python.
